'''Gerisch''' is a [[Seanchan]] [[Banner-General]].
== Activities ==
She is a [[Banner-General]] in the Seanchan army. [[Mat Cauthon]] tells her she has a nice backside. 

During the [[Last Battle]], she is present when Mat's orders to [[Lan Mandragoran]] are relayed to the [[Shara]]ns, and he suspects her of potentially being a spy.{{ref/book|14|28}}

== Trivia ==
* Gerisch is named for Margaret St. John, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''. The character's name comes from her maiden name.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
